# LV IT Consulting

> Independent SAP logistics consultancy based in Belgium, run by Lode Verschelde. Specialised in SAP EWM and WM implementations, solution design, interfaces and project management.

- **Company:** LV IT Consulting
- **Owner:** Lode Verschelde

- **Country:** Belgium
- **Email:** lode@lvit.be

- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/lodeverschelde/
- **Experience:** 14 years in IT, 12 years in SAP logistics. Freelance since 2019.

## Services

- SAP EWM and WM / HU implementations, template design and international roll-outs
- Solution design, process analysis and functional specifications
- Project management and solution architecture
- Interface design and troubleshooting: IDOC, qRFC and API
- Warehouse automation and AGV integration
- Data migration, stock uploads, testing, training, go-live and hypercare support
- ABAP debugging and root cause analysis

## Industries

Medical devices and life sciences, food and beverage manufacturing, building materials and interior products, textiles and floor coverings, distribution centres and 3PL operations.

## Countries delivered in

Belgium, the Netherlands, Sweden, Poland, France, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Turkey, Ivory Coast.

## Free SAP tools built by LV IT Consulting

- [SAP Barcode Generator](https://sapbarcode.lvit.be/): generates GS1-128 SSCC barcodes from a list of SSCC numbers and calculates SSCC check digits using the GS1 mod-10 algorithm.
- [SAP Timestamp Converter](https://saptime.lvit.be/): converts SAP timestamps between the raw ABAP format (YYYYMMDDHHmmss), the SAP GUI dot-formatted display and human-readable dates, with timezone support.
